description: Upgrade of existing telecommunications installation incorporating replacement of existing 14.5 metre monopole with 20 metre high monopole, and associated cabinets and works.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Notification Letter dated 6th August 2019, Declaration of Conformity with ICNIRP Public Exposure Guidelines, and Supplementary Information statement; Cover Letter dated 6th August 2019; and 5G and Future Technology - Delivering the UK's Telecoms Future statement received: 08/08/2019. 915195_HSW019_60711_TW0188_M002 Issue B  002 Site Location Drawing; 003 Access Plan; 005 Cherry Picker/Crane Location(s); 100 Existing Site Plan; 150 Existing Elevation A; 215 Maximum Configuration Site Plan; 265 Maximum Configuration Elevation; 304 Max Configuration Antenna Schedule & Line Configuration; and 305 Equipment Schedules & Support Structure Details) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Within 28 calendar days of the date of the apparatus hereby approved coming into use, the date of which shall be notified in writing to the Local Planning Authority no less than 14 calendar days prior, the existing apparatus shall be dismantled and removed from the site, including all associated debris.

Condition : 6 - The width of the footway and carriageway of the A4 Great West Road shall not be reduced or blocked and shall provide a clear passage for pedestrians and cyclists at all times. Access to the nearby bus stop shall also be maintained at all times.

Condition : 7 - The footway and carriageway on A4 Great West Road shall not be blocked during the construction and maintenance of the development. The construction shall not at any point encroach on the clear space needed to maintain the safe and uninterrupted flow of road users and pedestrians or disrupt bus operations. All vehicles associated with the installation shall not park/stop other than at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions.
